source_clause: C6.) Fan ranges: Off, 1-7, 15h (denoting to show AUTO instead). The status is indicated on TS climate screen and in main category control. Show pop-up when status is changed via hard control and currently shown screen is not climate screen. When on climate screen, user can either use Fan up/down (minus/plus) buttons, directly touch a fan segment to jump or slide, or use Hard Control. The user shall not be able to turn the FAN off by using the FAN controls on the screen or the FAN hard control. There would always be one bar highlighted. The only way to have all FAN bars grayed out is by shutting the CLIMATE system OFF (using climate power button on the screen or hard control).
reasoning: 驗證目標：2.7（C6）定出風量之範圍與呈現位置、非 climate screen 時之 popup、climate screen 上之三種調整途徑，以及「風量不可手動關至全暗」此一限制與其唯一例外，五個 037 leaf 逐一對應，一葉一 TC（§8.2.1）。關鍵情境條件：可觀察量落於 TS climate screen 與 main category control，依 **R-C34** 補第十三軸與 EMEA ICS 之排除；**-01 另補第九軸** —— 其讀 main category control，而 6.3 使 comfort section 自 head unit 移除，故該介面可能不存在，標 (6.3) 並併入 specification_reference；其餘四條之可觀察量在 climate screen 與 popup，不受第九軸影響。為什麼這樣切：三種調整途徑與兩項限制之失效互相獨立。刻意略過：條文之 `15h` 標示 AUTO 一項語意不明（未見於他節），本批不驗，僅驗 Off 與 1-7 之呈現；-02 與 `002-02`（2.2 之 popup）形態相近而 leaf 不同，依 §8.2 各自成條，本條之主詞為風量、該條為一般性狀態變更；**A-CF23 之逐條複查（42 §4 之名單重建）**：037 對本 leaf 之描述帶 1 張圖，五條之答**皆為否** —— `fan segment`／`one bar highlighted`／`all FAN bars grayed out`／`main category control`／`pop-up` 五個可觀察量**全部是 C6 自己的字**，ER 未使用任何條文以外之視覺描述。

distinguishing_axis.axis: 所控之氣候區（前排 vs 後排）—— 同一行為在兩區之兩處陳述
distinguishing_axis.delta: `2.7` 之主體為**前排**風速（值域、三種調整途徑、不可自畫面關閉之限制），`7.5` 之主體為**後排**同一風速（值域、三種調整途徑、不可自畫面關閉之限制）（鏡射表記其為 partial／mirrored）。**§10.6 逐項**：trigger 之操作對象不同（前排控制 vs 後排控制）、outcome 之可觀察量不同（前排風速格 vs 後排風速格）、input 皆 NA、verification target 各為該區之行為。**四項中兩項相異 → 非嚴格等價，`duplicate_of` 不填。** 與 `2.9`↔`16.9` 之四對逐字等價不同：**該對之兩側互斥**（同一車不可能既 ICS 又非 ICS），**本對之兩側並存**（一台四區車同時有前排與後排），故兩條 TC 於同一車上皆須執行

tcs.tc_title: Fan speed shows on the climate screen and category control
tcs.test_item:
The status is indicated on TS climate screen and in main category control.

(The head unit provides a main category control for climate; read the main category control)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The head unit provides a main category control for climate (2.7)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
4. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not configured with a non-foldable secondary lower screen containing comfort information, for which the comfort section is removed from the head unit (6.3)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Open the climate screen
2. Change the fan speed
3. Read the main category control
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows the current fan speed
2. The climate screen shows the new fan speed
3. The main category control shows the new fan speed
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.test_item_authored: The fan status shall be indicated on the TS climate screen and in the main category control

tcs.tc_title: The fan up button increases the fan speed
tcs.test_item:
When on climate screen, user can either use Fan up/down (minus/plus) buttons, directly touch a fan segment to jump or slide, or use Hard Control.

(The climate screen provides fan up and down buttons and fan segments; press the fan up button on the climate screen)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The climate screen provides fan up and down buttons and fan segments (2.7)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Note the fan speed shown on the climate screen
2. Press the fan up button on the climate screen
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows the current fan speed
2. The fan speed increases
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.split_reason: §8.2.2 之拆分，依 75 §1 之判準（**條文列舉之項即拆分之維度**）：本節之條文逐字列舉其觸發 —— 「user can either use Fan up/down (minus/plus) buttons, directly touch a fan segment to jump or slide, or use Hard Control」—— 故一觸發一條。三條輸入路徑各自可失效（按鍵可用而滑動失效，是一種失效）。 （**判準之反面**：條文以泛稱表述而由作者挑樣者不拆，其樣本為 interaction data，§4.5。）

tcs.tc_title: The screen fan controls cannot turn the fan off
tcs.test_item:
The user shall not be able to turn the FAN off by using the FAN controls on the screen or the FAN hard control.

(The vehicle has a fan speed hard control; press the fan down button on the climate screen repeatedly until the fan speed stops decreasing)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has a fan speed hard control (2.7)
2. [spec-derived] The vehicle does not have 3 knob HVAC controls with ICS, for which no HVAC screens or pop ups are displayed (2.14)
3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Note the fan speed shown on the climate screen
2. Press the fan down button on the climate screen repeatedly until the fan speed stops decreasing
tcs.expected_result:
1. The climate screen shows the current fan speed
2. The fan is not off and one fan bar remains highlighted
tcs.design_method: 邊界值分析 (Boundary Value Analysis, BVA)
tcs.split_reason: §8.2.2 之拆分，依 75 §1 之判準（**條文列舉之項即拆分之維度**）：本節之條文逐字列舉其觸發 —— 「The user shall not be able to turn the FAN off by using the FAN controls on the screen or the FAN hard control」—— 故一觸發一條。兩個控制面各自可失效：畫面上關不掉而硬控關得掉，是一種失效。 （**判準之反面**：條文以泛稱表述而由作者挑樣者不拆，其樣本為 interaction data，§4.5。）

tcs.tc_title: All fan bars grey out only when the climate system is off
tcs.test_item:
The only way to have all FAN bars grayed out is by shutting the CLIMATE system OFF (using climate power button on the screen or hard control).

tcs.pre_conditions:
1. [spec-derived] The vehicle has a climate power hard control (2.7)

3. [spec-derived] The vehicle is not an EMEA ICS vehicle, whose climate interface is specified separately in chapter 16 (16.2)

2. Turn the climate system on again
3. Turn the climate system off using the climate power hard control
tcs.expected_result:
1. All FAN bars are greyed out
2. One fan bar is highlighted
3. All FAN bars are greyed out
